text: ChatGPT has one point two billion weekly users, and now your business can claim its own profile there. Here's what you get. You claim and verify your business in OpenAI's Business Hub. A blue check appears on your profile once it's claimed. You can update your details and upload product feeds with prices and availability. You see how often ChatGPT mentions you and how many people click to your website. Discovery topics show the conversation themes where your site gets cited. Eligible US stores and online services can also launch a Business Agent that answers shopper questions. OpenAI's pages list no price, and Shopify stores can connect in three steps. The catch. Claiming does not guarantee higher placement or more sales. If you sell online, claim your profile now so ChatGPT quotes your current prices. Send this to the friend who runs an online store.
